band.name: Harbour Sons
band.tagline: Salt-worn folk from the low country
band.blurb: Sea shanties, string-band roots and windswept covers — played loud enough to carry across the water.

about.heading: Two chords, a rising tide
body: Harbour Sons play the songs that get sung when the boats are in — old water-worn ballads, folk standards and the odd country lament, arranged for close harmony and whatever instruments fit in the van.
We started out playing for friends on a quayside in the summer of 2025. It has not got much more complicated than that since.

contact.note: For bookings, festivals and private events — drop us a line and we’ll come to you.

marquee: Blue Eyes Crying In The Rain
